name: Notifiable Data Breaches scheme
owner: Office of the Australian Information Commissioner
description: Mandatory breach-notification scheme under Privacy Act 1988 (secid:regulation/oaic.gov.au/privacy-act) Part IIIC, in force since February 2018. Requires APP entities to notify OAIC and affected individuals of eligible data breaches likely to cause serious harm.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (oaic.gov.au) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (oaic.gov.au).
